authentication.bootBinding: Every proxy open binds the exact verified kernel, initrd and read-only root-disk tuple of one running VM.
authentication.freshness: The trusted Mac host supplies a fresh non-zero 32-byte nonce and accepts only an exact echo.
authentication.guestIdentity: The Mac host reaches this listener only through the VZVirtioSocketDevice owned by the exact verified VM.
authentication.hostIdentity: The guest accepts only the kernel-reported AF_VSOCK peer CID VMADDR_CID_HOST (2).
authentication.launcherIdentity: The guest opens only /run/boole/native-shadow/launcher.sock and reports kernel-observed SO_PEERCRED values. PID must be non-zero and UID/GID must both be root.
authentication.protocolBinding: Every open and ready frame carries the SHA-256 digest of this complete contract.
